# Amazing-Luogu
> Userscript for enhancing Luogu OJ web experience for OI contestants.

Site: https://amlg.top/
Repo: https://github.com/Snow-Domain-Smart-Fox/Amazing-Luogu

## Pages
- [Home](https://amlg.top/#home): Project homepage
- [Explore](https://amlg.top/#explore): Feature introduction
- [Users](https://amlg.top/#users): User information
- [About](https://amlg.top/#about): About this project

## Project
Amazing-Luogu is a userscript for Luogu OJ.
It provides UI optimization and problem-solving helper features for OI players.
